preConversation.script: Watch how fractions change from 1/2 to 1/4 to 1/6. Pay attention!

probes: If you cut a cake into 4 slices vs 6 slices, which way makes more pieces?
Look at the bottom numbers - 4 and 6. Which number is bigger?
More cuts = more pieces. Does 1/4 or 1/6 have more cuts?
6 is bigger than 4. So which fraction has more pieces?
1/6 has more pieces! 6 is more than 4. Good thinking!
If you cut a cake into 4 vs 6 slices, which has more pieces?
Look at the numbers - 4 and 6. Which is bigger?
6 is bigger than 4. So which has more pieces?
1/6 has more pieces! 6 pieces is more than 4 pieces.
